title: SIT724 Reliability Judgement Log Entry
description: One record per (rater, blinded item) pair. Captures the judgement behind a rubric score, not just the score itself, per Jack's 5 Aug 2026 feedback. Entries stay blinded (blind_id / case_id / variant_index) until an unblinding map is applied; they do not store model name.

rater_id.description: Who made this judgement, e.g. 'SS' (human peer) or 'GLM-5.2' (AI judge). Must match the rater_id used in the scoring/kappa calculation.

pack_id.description: Blinded form / pack identifier the rater scored, e.g. 'sit724-150-bycase-…-seed724'.

run_id.description: The pipeline run directory this response came from (matches the write-once timestamped run folder).

blind_id.description: Blinded item id from the peer-review pack, e.g. 'I001'. Shared across raters so rows join item-for-item without revealing the model.

case_id.description: References the case id in cases/cases.json, e.g. 'Q1'.

variant_index.description: Which of the (usually 5) blinded AI replies for this case the rater scored, 1-based.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the exact prompt sent (from the pipeline's existing hashing), so this entry is provably tied to the locked prompt version.

rubric_scores.description: This rater's 1-5 score for each of the 7 rubric dimensions (rubric/rubric.json), for this response.

judgement.description: accept = scores stand as-is and response is usable as evidence. reject = response is unusable for this case and is excluded, with reasoning logged. refine = rater's own understanding of the correct rubric score changed after closer reading; refine_detail explains what should change.

reasoning.description: Free-text reflection: what was asked, what the AI actually said, and WHY this judgement was made — not just the score.

refine_detail.description: Required non-empty when judgement is 'refine'. Empty string for accept/reject.

timestamp.description: When this judgement was made (not when the response was generated).
